name: bodenschutz-austria
description: Bodenschutz Austria – Vom Foto zum Angebot: App, Backend, Website, KI-Berater und E-Mail-Automatik

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix packages/rules install && npm --prefix packages/rules run build && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/api run db:setup && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,mail -c green,blue,yellow "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "maildev --smtp 1025 --web 1080"
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/rules run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/rules test && npm --prefix apps/api test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/rules run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
